parsing_rationale: The document is a comprehensive task list for a Football Match Manager. I have mapped the phases to 'phase' nodes and the individual tasks (T001-T070) to 'task' nodes. The dependencies section provided a clear linear chain of prerequisites which I have mapped as 'depends_on' relationships. User stories are treated as phases that contain specific tasks. Structural gaps were identified for sections like 'Security & Performance Constraints' and 'Open Questions' which are not explicitly detailed in the raw markdown.

project_info.brief_explanation: Implementation of a football match tracking system allowing users to view, filter, and follow matches.
project_info.source_context: Task list derived from design documents in /specs/001-football-match-manager/

sections.title: Tasks: Football Match Manager
sections.raw_content:
**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/001-football-match-manager/`

**Prerequisites**: plan.md (required), spec.md (required for user stories), research.md, data-model.md, contracts/api.md

**Tests**: Tests are OPTIONAL - only include them if explicitly requested in the feature specification.

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story to enable independent implementation and testing of each story.

sections.title: Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`
sections.raw_content:
- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies)
- **[Story]**: Which user story this task belongs to (e.g., US1, US2, US3)
- Include exact file paths in descriptions

sections.title: Path Conventions
sections.raw_content:
- **Web app**: `backend/src/`, `frontend/src/`

- [ ] T015 [P] Create base Express app structure in backend/src/app.ts

- [ ] T018 [P] Create error handling middleware
- [ ] T019 [P] Setup API routes structure (auth, matches, follows, teams, leagues)

sections.title: Implementation Strategy
sections.raw_content:
**MVP Scope**: Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3 (Viewing Match List)

This provides a working application where users can:
- View a list of football matches
- Filter matches by league and date
- See match details (teams, venue, time, league)

**Incremental Delivery**:
1. Start with Phase 1 (Setup) - establishes project foundation
2. Complete Phase 2 (Foundational) - database and API infrastructure
3. Implement Phase 3 (US1) - core user-facing feature
4. Add remaining user stories incrementally
5. Finish with Phase 8 (Polish) - testing and documentation

structural_gaps.remediation_advice: The document mentions 'Independent Tests' for each story, but these should be formalized into a dedicated Acceptance Criteria section for each task.
